examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Display Time
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the display time using showTime, useMilitaryTime, and dateTimeOptions.

examples.title: Example 2: Customizing the Style
examples.description: In this example, disappearTextStyle, textStyle, selectedTextStyle, acceptButtonStyle, and cancelButtonStyle are configured to customize the text and button style.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring a Dialog Box in the Hover State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the layout area of a dialog box when the device is in semi-folded mode.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Dialog Box Position
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the position of a dialog box using alignment and offset.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Mask Area
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the mask area using maskRect.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the Background
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the dialog box background using backgroundColor, backgroundBlurStyle, and shadow.

examples.title: Example 7: Switching Between Gregorian and Lunar Calendars
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the date picker dialog box to display either the Gregorian (solar) calendar or the lunar calendar using lunar and lunarSwitch.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting Display of Month and Day Columns
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure the mode parameter to display only the month and day columns in the date picker dialog box.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting Cyclic Scrolling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set whether to enable cyclic scrolling using canLoop, available since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 10: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background blur effect by configuring backgroundBlurStyleOptions, available since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 11: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background effect by configuring backgroundEffect. This functionality is supported since API version 19.
